critical_code_review_comments: ModeBebe.jsx line 83: data-testid is 'baby-locked-screen' but the review_request listed 'baby-lock-screen'. The actual lock BUTTON correctly uses 'baby-lock-screen' (line 166); the locked OVERLAY uses 'baby-locked-screen'. Both exist and are distinct — not a bug, just different names for different states.

Assistant.jsx line 130: 'text-xs font-black text-purple-600 uppercase' — CSS text-transform makes innerText return 'POWERED BY CLAUDE AI' (rendered), so any test that uses case-sensitive substring check for 'Powered by Claude AI' against innerText will fail. Use DOM textContent (raw) or case-insensitive matching.
ModeChretien.jsx uses inline setTimeout chains (lines 62-65, 218) without cleanup on unmount — low-priority leak if user navigates away during playSequence.
ModeParent.jsx circular progress stroke uses strokeDasharray with percent — correctly animated via duration-700 transition.
